verified_external_tools.name: P7_FREE_LIST_3_COLORING
verified_external_tools.source: Bonomo, Chudnovsky, Maceli, Schaudt, Stein, Zhong, Combinatorica 38(4), 2018
verified_external_tools.verified_claim: List 3-Colouring is polynomial-time solvable on P7-free graphs and the algorithm gives an explicit coloring if one exists.
verified_external_tools.role: Produce an auxiliary proper 3-coloring of H_sigma=G[S_sigma], hence a partition S_sigma=R1 disjoint_union R2 disjoint_union R3 into stable sets.
verified_external_tools.firewall: The auxiliary coloring is a structural certificate only; it is not committed as the coloring used by a global extension.

verified_external_tools.name: P7_FREE_BIPARTITE_CHAIN_DECOMPOSITION
verified_external_tools.source: Lozin and Zamaraev, European Journal of Combinatorics 65 (2017), 143-153
verified_claims: Every P7-free bipartite graph is chain-decomposable.
For an n-vertex chain-decomposable bipartite graph with n>=3, its decomposition tree has at most 8n-17 nodes.
verified_external_tools.role: Existing decomposition backend after the local incidence-lift theorem certifies each I_{sigma,i} is P7-free bipartite.

verified_external_tools.name: P7_FREE_BIPARTITE_MIM_WIDTH_CONSEQUENCE
verified_external_tools.source: Chudnovsky, Czyzewska, Kluk, Pilipczuk, Rzazewski, Sparse induced subgraphs in P7-free graphs of bounded clique number, ISAAC 2025 / full version
verified_external_tools.verified_claim: The Lozin-Zamaraev structural analysis implies bounded mim-width for P7-free bipartite graphs and a corresponding decomposition can be found efficiently.
verified_external_tools.warning: The same source explicitly notes that richer extension variants may require information not handled by the known bounded-mim-width algorithms.

verified_external_tools.name: FIXED_K_LIST_COLORING_ON_BOUNDED_QUICKLY_COMPUTABLE_MIM_WIDTH
verified_external_tools.source: Brettell, Horsfield, Munaro, Paulusma, Information Processing Letters 173 (2022), 106168
verified_external_tools.verified_claim: For fixed k, List k-Colouring is polynomial-time solvable on graph classes of bounded and quickly computable mim-width.
verified_external_tools.role: Related existing algorithmic backend only; not yet a proof that the three shared-right-side layers compose.

no_reinvention: Do not develop a new decomposition theory for each I_{sigma,i}.
Do not attack general bounded symmetric difference for P7-free bipartite graphs.
Do not classify all survivor-survivor chords before using the auxiliary stable-layer split.
Do not claim bounded mim-width of the union of the three layers from bounded mim-width of each layer.
Do not open B1B synchronization in this execution.
